final_template:
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
  }
}

# Variable toggles
variable "create_developers_group" {
  description = "Enable creation of the developers IAM group"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "create_readonly_s3_policy" {
  description = "Enable creation of the DeveloperReadOnlyAndS3FullAccess policy"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "create_screenshot_policy" {
  description = "Enable creation of the EC2GetConsoleScreenshot policy"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "create_group_policy_attachment" {
  description = "Enable attachment of the readonly_s3 policy to the group"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "create_user_policy_attachment" {
  description = "Enable attachment of the screenshot policy to users"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "create_jack_user" {
  description = "Enable creation of IAM user jack"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "create_jones_user" {
  description = "Enable creation of IAM user jones"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "create_user_group_membership" {
  description = "Enable adding users to the developers group"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "create_ec2_role" {
  description = "Enable creation of the instance_role IAM role"
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

# Locals for reusable values
locals {
  developers_group_name = "developers"
  readonly_s3_policy_name = "DeveloperReadOnlyAndS3FullAccess"
  screenshot_policy_name = "EC2GetConsoleScreenshot"
  instance_role_name = "instance_role"

  # Build list of user names from created users only
  created_user_names = compact([
    var.create_jack_user ? aws_iam_user.jack[0].name : "",
    var.create_jones_user ? aws_iam_user.jones[0].name : "",
  ])
}

# Data sources for policy documents
data "aws_iam_policy_document" "readonly_s3" {
  count = var.create_readonly_s3_policy ? 1 : 0

  statement {
    sid    = "IAMReadOwnUser"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "iam:Get*",
      "iam:List*",
    ]
    resources = ["arn:aws:iam::*:user/$${aws:username}"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "S3FullAccess"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "s3:AbortMultipartUpload",
      "s3:DeleteBucket",
      "s3:DeleteBucketPolicy",
      "s3:DeleteBucketWebsite",
      "s3:DeleteObject",
      "s3:DeleteObjectTagging",
      "s3:DeleteObjectVersion",
      "s3:DeleteObjectVersionTagging",
      "s3:GetAccelerateConfiguration",
      "s3:GetBucketAcl",
      "s3:GetBucketCORS",
      "s3:GetBucketLocation",
      "s3:GetBucketLogging",
      "s3:GetBucketNotification",
      "s3:GetBucketObjectLockConfiguration",
      "s3:GetBucketPolicy",
      "s3:GetBucketPolicyStatus",
      "s3:GetBucketPublicAccessBlock",
      "s3:GetBucketRequestPayment",
      "s3:GetBucketTagging",
      "s3:GetBucketVersioning",
      "s3:GetBucketWebsite",
      "s3:GetEncryptionConfiguration",
      "s3:GetInventoryConfiguration",
      "s3:GetLifecycleConfiguration",
      "s3:GetMetricsConfiguration",
      "s3:GetObject",
      "s3:GetObjectAcl",
      "s3:GetObjectLegalHold",
      "s3:GetObjectRetention",
      "s3:GetObjectTagging",
      "s3:GetObjectTorrent",
      "s3:GetObjectVersion",
      "s3:GetObjectVersionAcl",
      "s3:GetObjectVersionForReplication",
      "s3:GetObjectVersionTagging",
      "s3:GetObjectVersionTorrent",
      "s3:GetReplicationConfiguration",
      "s3:ListAllMyBuckets",
      "s3:ListBucket",
      "s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads",
      "s3:ListBucketVersions",
      "s3:ListMultipartUploadParts",
      "s3:PutAccelerateConfiguration",
      "s3:PutBucketAcl",
      "s3:PutBucketCORS",
      "s3:PutBucketLogging",
      "s3:PutBucketNotification",
      "s3:PutBucketObjectLockConfiguration",
      "s3:PutBucketPolicy",
      "s3:PutBucketPublicAccessBlock",
      "s3:PutBucketRequestPayment",
      "s3:PutBucketTagging",
      "s3:PutBucketVersioning",
      "s3:PutBucketWebsite",
      "s3:PutEncryptionConfiguration",
      "s3:PutInventoryConfiguration",
      "s3:PutLifecycleConfiguration",
      "s3:PutMetricsConfiguration",
      "s3:PutObject",
      "s3:PutObjectAcl",
      "s3:PutObjectLegalHold",
      "s3:PutObjectRetention",
      "s3:PutObjectTagging",
      "s3:PutReplicationConfiguration",
      "s3:ReplicateDelete",
      "s3:ReplicateObject",
      "s3:ReplicateTags",
      "s3:RestoreObject"
    ]
    resources = ["arn:aws:s3:::*"]
  }
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "screenshot" {
  count = var.create_screenshot_policy ? 1 : 0

  statement {
    sid    = "EC2GetConsoleScreenshot"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:GetConsoleScreenshot"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

# IAM Group
resource "aws_iam_group" "developers" {
  count = var.create_developers_group ? 1 : 0
  name  = local.developers_group_name
}

# Custom policy: readonly + S3
resource "aws_iam_policy" "readonly_s3" {
  count       = var.create_readonly_s3_policy ? 1 : 0
  name        = local.readonly_s3_policy_name
  description = "Grants read-only IAM to own user and full S3 access"
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.readonly_s3[0].json
}

# Custom policy: screenshot
resource "aws_iam_policy" "screenshot" {
  count       = var.create_screenshot_policy ? 1 : 0
  name        = local.screenshot_policy_name
  description = "Allows ec2:GetConsoleScreenshot on any instance"
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.screenshot[0].json
}

# Attach readonly_s3 policy to group
resource "aws_iam_group_policy_attachment" "readonly_s3_group" {
  count      = var.create_group_policy_attachment && var.create_developers_group && var.create_readonly_s3_policy ? 1 : 0
  group      = aws_iam_group.developers[0].name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.readonly_s3[0].arn
}

# IAM Users
resource "aws_iam_user" "jack" {
  count = var.create_jack_user ? 1 : 0
  name  = "jack"
}

resource "aws_iam_user" "jones" {
  count = var.create_jones_user ? 1 : 0
  name  = "jones"
}

# Attach screenshot policy to users
resource "aws_iam_user_policy_attachment" "screenshot_jack" {
  count      = var.create_user_policy_attachment && var.create_screenshot_policy && var.create_jack_user ? 1 : 0
  user       = aws_iam_user.jack[0].name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.screenshot[0].arn
}

resource "aws_iam_user_policy_attachment" "screenshot_jones" {
  count      = var.create_user_policy_attachment && var.create_screenshot_policy && var.create_jones_user ? 1 : 0
  user       = aws_iam_user.jones[0].name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.screenshot[0].arn
}

# Group membership
resource "aws_iam_group_membership" "developers" {
  count = var.create_user_group_membership && var.create_developers_group ? 1 : 0
  name  = "${local.developers_group_name}-membership"
  group = aws_iam_group.developers[0].name
  users = local.created_user_names
}

# IAM Role for EC2
resource "aws_iam_role" "instance_role" {
  count = var.create_ec2_role ? 1 : 0
  name  = local.instance_role_name

  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Effect = "Allow"
        Principal = {
          Service = "ec2.amazonaws.com"
        }
        Action = "sts:AssumeRole"
      }
    ]
  })
}

# Attach AWS managed IAMReadOnlyAccess to role
resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "readonly_role" {
  count      = var.create_ec2_role ? 1 : 0
  role       = aws_iam_role.instance_role[0].name
  policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMReadOnlyAccess"
}
